gui.slidingplatforms.lock.trusted_hint: Can only open/close the platform. Sensor and redstone keep working.
gui.slidingplatforms.cascade.title: Cascade
gui.slidingplatforms.cascade.hint1: The platform is sliced into rows along its travel and moves in a relay, like a curtain.
gui.slidingplatforms.cascade.hint2: Closing runs in reverse order — from the far edge back to the root.
gui.slidingplatforms.cascade.hint3: Elevator rides stay whole: a platform carrying people moves as one.
gui.slidingplatforms.cascade.hint4: Inverted: the root-side row is pulled first — the edge releases last.
gui.slidingplatforms.cfg.title: Sliding Platforms Config
gui.slidingplatforms.cfg.hint1: Edits are written to config/slidingplatforms.json and apply at once.
gui.slidingplatforms.cfg.hint2: Players who never open this menu see no change at all.
gui.slidingplatforms.cfg.free_hint1: Custom numbers apply at once — no preset steps.
gui.slidingplatforms.cfg.free_hint2: Speed is blocks per tick: 900 bl/s = 45.
gui.slidingplatforms.cfg.warn: Values that are too large may cause lag, freezes and even crashes!
gui.slidingplatforms.autoclose_hint: Closes an open platform leaf after N s unless something holds it open.
